study.question: Does preserving the four match-group identities in the learned readout improve validation AUC beyond the frozen source bests and balanced_target, and does it make target queries more useful than context queries at identical allocated capacity and measured cost?
study.hypothesis: Observed source-level limitation: balanced_target retains four unweighted group pools and count/action-age features, but its separate-field learned contributions are summed across all groups into one d-vector before classification. This loses the group labels of the selected evidence. The local diagnostic receipt reports 2.025 occupied groups per impression and 0.761719 multigroup fraction on the first 512 validation impressions; this is a small candidate-supplied diagnostic, not a full-population estimate. Equal-group target AUC is 0.6202303848951921 versus context 0.6200080603081299 (difference 0.0002223245870622), while the earlier global hybrid favors context (0.6200552832670622 versus target 0.6198705487628978). Target conditioning is not consistently supported. Negative trajectories remain relevant: retaining raw magnitude reduces target AUC to 0.6196326414742833 while improving logloss to 0.195014679854263 from 0.19580821131534318; per-group premix norm matching yields 0.6199113682646937 target and 0.6199145943717271 context; density-based group mass yields 0.6199695090490825 target and 0.6201514112929118 context. These successful executions with worse AUC are scientific counterevidence to those implementations, not execution failures or a refutation of all group-aware readouts. Exact same-seed baseline reproductions across rounds are not independent replications. Provisional mechanism: a fixed group-resolved readout lets the classifier distinguish which semantic group supplied learned evidence, beyond what its unweighted pools provide. This might improve utility, with a positive layout-by-query interaction if collapse specifically concealed useful target conditioning. The present evidence motivates the test but does not demonstrate label-relevant collisions or complementary mechanisms.

Embedding dimension 16, original field embeddings, action/recency tables, category/brand match rules excluding zero missing IDs, four unweighted group pools, four log-count features and 64 observed action-age histogram features.

study.proposed_difference: For valid event i define v_i = w_c,i*c_i + w_b,i*b_i + 0.5*(w_c,i+w_b,i)*common_i, with exactly the parent event weights. Form r_g = sum_{i in g} v_i via [B,4,L] bmm [B,L,d]; sum_g r_g reconstructs the parent raw readout. Let N(z,p)=z*||p||/||z|| for ||z||>1e-6, otherwise p, and lift(p)=concat(p,p,p,p)/2. Resolved layout is N(concat(r_0,r_1,r_2,r_3),lift(pooled)); collapsed layout is lift(N(sum_i v_i,pooled)). Both are 4*d vectors with norm ||pooled||, including finite fallbacks. No individual group normalization is introduced. All four cells compute both layouts and differ only in group_slots and target_query. Original 420 features are unchanged; appended width increases from 16 to 64, total width 484. Expected total parameters 17,153,315 (17,078,688 embedding; 74,627 dense), +6,144 over balanced_target. All four have identical Model AST and allocated parameter shapes/order. Collapsed slots repeat the parent readout isometrically and supply no additional readout information: setting each block of classifier weights to half the parent weights embeds the parent function exactly. This matches allocated capacity, not effective feature rank or optimizer conditioning. The resolved direction and induced optimization geometry change together. The contrast tests the utility of this group-resolved representation, not a uniquely identified causal explanation or a novelty claim.
predictions: Primary utility: slots_target should exceed g1-r0006-paired_match, g2-r0001-target_separate and g3-r0007-balanced_target on full-population validation AUC, and exceed collapsed_target under the same wider architecture. Logloss and all available cost metrics must be reported regardless of direction.

Conditioning: slots_target should exceed slots_context, and the interaction (AUC(slots_target)-AUC(slots_context))-(AUC(collapsed_target)-AUC(collapsed_context)) should be positive. If only both resolved layouts improve, group-resolved utility may be supported while a conditioning-specific explanation remains unsupported.

Structural checks should show group sums reconstruct the parent raw vector, occupied-group attention mass equals 1/K, all layouts have pooled norm, empty and zero-length histories remain finite with zero history features, and masked padding/history order do not materially affect outputs.

At fixed readout contributions, permuting group labels should leave collapsed coordinates unchanged and generally alter resolved coordinates. This tests representation sensitivity, not usefulness or a valid counterfactual history.

Any observed AUC effect is preliminary at seed 42. Seek consistent paired-seed effects before claiming repeated support; do not call deterministic same-seed reproductions independent evidence. No significance claim without authorized paired uncertainty estimation.
falsifiers: Failure of slots_target to beat either source best or balanced_target leaves incremental utility unsupported; a gain only versus the wider collapsed control cannot establish practical improvement over the best existing model.

Failure of slots_target to beat slots_context, or a nonpositive interaction with query source, leaves conditioning-specific benefit unsupported. Improvement matched by slots_context supports at most group-resolved readout utility.
If collapsed_target/context improve as much as the corresponding resolved layouts, extra allocated columns, initialization, conditioning or stochastic training are adequate alternative explanations.

Large reconstruction/norm/mask errors, nonfinite logits/gradients, untracked input changes, or an exceeded host cap invalidate the intended comparison. Retain receipts and charged costs; do not patch host contracts.

If gains disappear across paired seeds, remain dependent on one metric with an adverse tradeoff, or are dominated at measured equal compute/inference cost, restrict or reject the practical conclusion. A single unsuccessful implementation does not refute every group-preserving mechanism.
alternative_explanations: Original unweighted group pools and count tables already encode enough group information; learned group slots may add no label-relevant signal.

Wider inputs increase allocated classifier weights and change initialization and Adam conditioning. The repeated collapsed representation exactly matches information and parameter count but has lower feature rank; richer effective information capacity is intrinsic to the intervention and is not independently controlled.

Final flattened norm is controlled, but group resolution changes the representation direction and how cross-group coherence is represented. Equal flat norms do not establish matched per-coordinate distributions or a uniquely isolated group-identity cause.
Query-dependent matching was already present in group membership. Context-query performance is not a target-free baseline; it only removes target dependence from query construction.

Selecting after many seed-42 validation trajectories incurs adaptive selection risk. Small AUC differences can reflect seed noise, and logloss can favor a different representation, as the earlier magnitude/density results show.

First-512 diagnostics are candidate supplied and may not represent full-population group prevalence. Sparse brand groups may overfit; no unexposed older history, item identities, conversion labels or external-domain inputs may be assumed.
The publisher static user/ad snapshots have undocumented as-of dates. Retain the frozen benchmark assumption rather than claim verified production point-in-time validity.
